description: Signalsmith Stretch 1.3.2 (MIT, with Signalsmith Linear, MIT) as its WebAssembly module factory, vendored for @taalcut/audio's time-stretch. Unchanged code; the Web Audio worklet wrapper is left out. See README.md.

changes: src/signalsmith-stretch.mjs is lines 3-16 of upstream/SignalsmithStretch.mjs (the Emscripten module factory with the WebAssembly binary inlined) followed by `export default SignalsmithStretch;`, with a two-line comment on top.
